Contents

Page numbers match the current text size.

Swipe up / down to move · pinch to jump there · swipe left to go back.

Controls

Pick an action, then perform the gesture you want for it — a swipe, a pinch, an index-finger click, a middle-finger click. The reader captures whatever it sends.

Bindings apply on the reading screen. Inside menus, swipes and pinch always navigate, so you can never lock yourself out.
